purpose: Qualitative prioritization signals for the existing Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are not measured search volumes, prevalence estimates or truth evidence; community material is discovery-only and material healthcare-cost guidance must be verified against current primary sources.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize recurring natural-language demand where users face high information friction, meaningful consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative, not measured search volumes.

natural_language_queries: jag har inte råd att gå till vårdcentralen
vad kostar vårdcentralen och gäller frikort
jag har inte råd med medicinen på apoteket
är högkostnadsskyddet samma för vård och läkemedel
jag har medicinkostnader och pengarna räcker inte till mat och hyra
لا أستطيع تحمل تكلفة زيارة المركز الصحي
آیا حمایت هزینه دارو و ویزیت یکی است

demand_signal.basis: Open-web question and discussion material repeatedly shows people combining care access, medicine cost, frikort and income problems in one natural-language question. This is qualitative discovery only, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The same everyday word 'högkostnadsskydd' can refer to distinct systems. 1177 explicitly separates outpatient healthcare from medicines and also distinguishes dental cost rules, while exact patient fees can vary by region. A generic cost answer can therefore send the user to the wrong truth path.

miss_consequence.basis: Confusing visit fees, prescription-medicine protection and dental costs can cause a user to delay care, misunderstand a frikort or miss the correct cost-checking route. If food or housing is also at risk, hiding the economic-assistance path increases consequence further.

source_fragmentation.basis: 1177 carries national and region-specific patient-fee guidance, E-hälsomyndigheten carries the medicine high-cost register and current transition information, and dental costs use separate responsible sources. The user should not need to know this institutional split in advance.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as frikort, patientavgift and högkostnadsskydd are system vocabulary rather than natural problem descriptions, and the distinction becomes harder across Swedish, Arabic and Persian. The product should classify the problem before asking the user to name the scheme.

steps_to_action.basis: The high-value information-gain split is the cost type: healthcare visit, prescription medicine or dental. If the cost type is already explicit, no generic questionnaire is needed; the next step is current primary-source verification and, where relevant, keeping basic-needs support visible.

recurrence_signal.basis: Open discussions recur around whether one frikort covers another cost category and around inability to afford medicines or care while income is constrained. Community examples are used only to discover recurring confusion, never to establish rules or amounts.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The current public quick-help surface supports only dental and vision modes, while the homepage advertises health among private-person needs. Generic person routing asks broader health/economy questions but does not provide a focused patient-fee versus medicine-cost boundary.

signals.product_miss: Stödassistenten has a dedicated dental-cost journey and broad economy/health routing, but no focused public navigation that distinguishes outpatient patient fees/frikort from prescription-medicine high-cost protection. This leaves a common natural-language confusion unresolved and risks treating several materially different cost systems as one.
signals.future_guardrail: Keep one product and one truth layer. Extend the existing quick-help/person routing rather than creating a healthcare-cost app. Ask only the cost type when it can change the route; reuse the existing dental route; keep economic assistance visible when basic needs are explicitly at risk; fail closed for professional/research wording; never hard-code exact fees or medicine ceilings without current primary-source and period/region context.
signals.evaluation_method: Natural-language scenario regressions + overlap/fail-closed cases + multilingual cases + current 1177/E-hälsomyndigheten/Försäkringskassan primary-source cross-check. Community material may only suggest cases and must never supply material rules.
signals.recommended_learning_action: Add a focused healthcare-cost branch inside the existing public intelligence: distinguish healthcare visit, prescription medicine and dental cost; reuse the dental path; preserve economic-assistance overlap; route exact regional/current values to primary sources instead of guessing.
signals.truth_rule: Community and search-language material are discovery signals only. Verify material patient-fee, frikort, medicine-benefit, high-cost amount, eligibility, regional fee, deadline and dental-support claims against the current responsible primary source before use. Keep outpatient healthcare and prescription medicines as separate high-cost-protection paths; do not represent them as one shared protection, and fail closed on exact region- or period-dependent values until verified.
